name: 27608 · Raleigh, NC
findings: ZIP 27608 (Raleigh) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27608 (Raleigh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27608 (Raleigh) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
